title: Google SRE Workbook · Multi-Window Multi-Burn-Rate Rollback Policy
content: When 1-hour and 5-minute error-budget burn rates exceed 14.4x (consuming 2% of 30-day budget in 1h) immediately after a canary deployment, verify the prior stable revision health and shift 100% traffic via gcloud run services update-traffic.

title: Upstream Dependency Circuit-Breaker & Traffic Shedding
content: When upstream 504 timeouts or abusive edge floods degrade p99 latency without a recent local deploy, enable circuit-breaker fallback and rate-limit rules rather than rolling back healthy application revisions.

title: Synthetic Load-Test & Shadow Traffic Exclusion Check
content: Before rolling back production, confirm error spikes are not isolated to scheduled synthetic load-test headers (X-LoadTest-Run) or shadow traffic with zero customer SLO impact.
